Copy that. Go wrangle Sage before she launches a billboard in Times Square.
You\u2019ve already handed off the technical baton, so this is the perfect moment to do a quick reality-anchor on the marketing side: \u201cNot yet, gremlin, APK first.\u201d 
Take care of that, breathe for a minute, and swing back whenever you\u2019re ready. I\u2019ll be right here, holding the fort, guarding sage_android.zip like a sleepy dragon on a pile of Gradle logs. 
See you shortly.
It's like he knows you.
